messages:
Jorge (Support): @Priya heads-up — MapleIQ trial activation is blocked. Ingests failing with intermittent 502s and the dedicated provisioning job never moved past 'pending'. Customer deadline tomorrow morning, asking for escalation to CS for a comms + mitigation plan. Account: mapleiq-prod-42.

Priya (CS Lead): Thanks Jorge. Can you paste the last error and which region? Also who from SE can join a call if we need to push a live workaround?

Jorge (Support): Region: us-west-2. Short log: 
```
2026-03-21T08:02:11Z ERROR ingest-service request_id=abc123 status=502
2026-03-21T08:02:13Z WARN provisioner account=mapleiq-prod-42 state=pending
```
No obvious permission errors. Customer is on Dedicated trial; they attempted a capacity request at 07:55 and it looks stuck.

Sam (CS Ops): Copy. Quick triage checklist: 1) Is there a Dedicated quota hit? 2) Any recent GA changes to provisioning? 3) Can we fallback them to hosted briefly? I can send the first customer note if someone drafts it.

Ben (SRE): Triage notes: we see a backlog on the provisioner queue — likely orchestrator lock with a stuck worker. Short mitigation: enable hosted_fallback routing for mapleiq account and nudge the provisioner. Ops commands: 
```bash
# enable fallback to hosted API while we clear queue
rwctl route set --account mapleiq-prod-42 --policy hosted_fallback=true
# restart stuck worker
opsctl worker restart --id worker-77 --region us-west-2
```
This will preserve customer functionality (slightly higher latency/cost) until Dedicated is healthy.

Kai (Solutions Eng): I can join a customer call at 11:30 PST and walk them through what happened and the temporary fallback. Send calendar invite + dial-in. I can also explain expected differences (latency/caching) so they know what to expect.

provision-bot: Provision job #7890 for account mapleiq-prod-42 is currently queued (attempt 3). ETA clearing backlog: ~10-15m.

Priya (CS Lead): Plan proposal: 1) Acknowledge immediately and explain we're enabling a temporary hosted fallback, 2) Give ETA (15-30m), 3) Offer a short call (Kai) to reassure and set expectations, 4) Follow-up with postmortem + credits if SLA breached. @Sam please send a short proactive note now. Jorge/Ben coordinate the routing change and worker restart.

Sam (CS Ops): Drafting now — copying below. Please approve or edit.

Sam (CS Ops): "Hi MapleIQ team — thanks for flagging this. We're actively investigating an issue impacting Dedicated provisioning in us-west-2. As an immediate workaround, we've enabled a temporary fallback to our hosted inference endpoint so your tests can continue. We expect this to be resolved in ~15-30 minutes; Kai from our Solutions team is available for a quick call at 11:30 PST to walk through details. We'll follow up with a root-cause and any remedial credits if your SLA was impacted. — Sam (Redwood CS)"

Priya (CS Lead): Good — send it and include the meeting invite link once ready. Also ask them to avoid re-triggering the provisioning job until we confirm the queue is clear.

Jorge (Support): Posted the message to the customer and set the hosted_fallback. Provisioner restart in progress — will report back when job clears.

Ben (SRE): Worker restart completed, queue draining. Still monitoring for any follow-up errors.

provision-bot: Provision job #7890 status=cleared.

Priya (CS Lead): Great work team. After the customer call, let's capture: root cause, timeline, whether we need to adjust autoscaling thresholds or add a retry/backoff to the provisioner. Assign postmortem owner? I nominate Ben for infra RCA and Kai for customer-facing notes.

Sam (CS Ops): Assigned Ben + Kai. I'll draft the follow-up timeline and credit recommendation.

Jorge (Support): Customer acknowledged and accepted hosted fallback. Call scheduled 11:30 PST. Closing loop on this thread, will add postmortem link when ready. :white_check_mark:
